# @zap-studio/cache

> 标签: cache, eviction, fifo, lfu, lru, memoization, mfu, mru, ttl, typescript

## 简介

Zero-dependency in-memory key-value cache with pluggable eviction policies (LRU, LFU, MRU, MFU, FIFO), capacity limits, and optional TTL.

- 官网：https://www.zapstudio.dev/packages/cache
